title: Sub-Gaussian HDLSS Principal Component Analysis: High-Probability Theory and Numerical Evidence for NRM, CDM, and Block Noise Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2611.29058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study principal component analysis when the dimension d is much larger than the sample size n under an independent-factor sub-Gaussian model. The dual sample covariance is decomposed into a finite-rank score matrix, an isotropic bulk shift, and a high-probability remainder governed by the bulk trace \tau_0, Frobenius scale q_0, and largest noise eigenvalue b_0 = ||\Lambda_0||_{op}. This decomposition separates fixed-score HDLSS limits from joint limits in which n also grows. It shows that sequential noise reduction generally targets a score oracle containing a later-spike subtraction, while an oracle block correction avoids that subtraction when the signal rank is known. A parallel cross-data-matrix bound explains the benefit and cost of sample splitting. translated_title: 次高斯HDLSS主成分分析：NRM、CDM与分块噪声降噪的高概率理论与数值证据
translated_abstract: 我们在独立因子次高斯模型下研究维数 d 远大于样本量 n 时的主成分分析。将对偶样本协方差矩阵分解为一个有限秩得分矩阵、一个各向同性体移以及一个由体迹 τ₀、Frobenius 尺度 q₀ 和最大噪声特征值 b₀ = ||Λ₀||_op 所控制的高概率余项。该分解将固定得分情形下的 HDLSS 极限与 n 同步增长的联合极限区分开来。理论表明，序贯噪声降噪通常瞄准的是包含后续尖峰减除项的得分预言机，而在信号秩已知时，预言机分块校正可以避免这一减除。与之平行的交叉数据矩阵界则解释了样本分裂带来的收益与代价。每个配置重复 1000 次的可复现高斯因子模拟证实了得分预言机逼近、多尖峰减除以及特征值之间的分离。
tldr: 本文在独立因子次高斯模型下为HDLSS主成分分析建立了基于得分矩阵、体移与高概率余项的高概率分解理论，揭示了序贯降噪对应含后续尖峰减除的得分预言机而分块校正可避免该减除的机制，并解释了交叉数据矩阵方法中样本分裂的收益与代价，同时以千次重复模拟加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a high-probability decomposition theory for HDLSS PCA under an independent-factor sub-Gaussian model, showing that sequential noise reduction targets a score oracle containing a later-spike subtraction while oracle block correction avoids it, explains the benefit and cost of sample splitting via a cross-data-matrix bound, and validates the theory with large-scale simulations.
